title: Why Ocean Currents Shape Our World
hook: How do ocean currents keep London mild while Calgary at the same latitude freezes?
script: How do ocean currents keep London mild while Calgary at the same latitude freezes? The Gulf Stream carries warm tropical water north, acting like a giant ocean radiator. To keep this heat moving, cold polar water drops three thousand meters beneath the surface. This massive plunge creates the Denmark Strait Cataract, a waterfall three times taller than Angel Falls. Wind and Earth's rotation force these ocean currents to pile up into literal domes of water. Predicting these ocean current patterns is what reveals how climate shift will redefine tomorrow's weather. Without this hidden global highway, entire cities would freeze overnight.
